spanish: No reconozcan faces en el juicio; como el pequeño como el grande oigan; no teman de faces de varón, porque el juicio a Dios él; y la palabra que se endurezca de ustedes, acerquen a mí, y la oiré.

findings.issue: יקשה is qal imperfect 3ms (be hard/difficult). “se endurezca” is causative endurecer plus reflexive se and subjunctive, shifting the stem toward making itself hard or being made hard.
«palabra» narrows H1697 to the speech sense; the lemma also leaves matter/thing open and the morphology does not decide.
Both adjectives are anarthrous; unmarked el closes definiteness the morphology leaves open.
The suffix is 3rd masculine singular. “la” is feminine, matching Spanish palabra rather than the Hebrew masculine.

notes: 2mp ustedes, both faces, the verbless judgment clause, hiphil acerquen, and a mí otherwise match the tokens.
